frontier_selector.why: The presence of multiple yellow to reddish brown firm papules and nodules and the lack of abnormal serum lipid levels are most consistent with this diagnosis.

support_spans: Dense diffuse cellular infiltrate composed mainly of foamy histiocytic cells and multinucleated Touton cells mixed with lymphocytes and eosinophils
Spindle cells and increased numbers of collagen fibers in a storiform arrangement were visible in the deep dermis
Positive for CD68 and CD163, but negative for S100, CD1a, and Langerin
The nasal and oropharyngeal mucosa were also affected
No clinical evidence of internal involvement was found on ultrasonography, computed tomography, or magnetic resonance imaging results
contradict_spans: Routine laboratory test results and serum chemistry with serum lipid levels were within normal ranges
